svg.text: The trust boundary — how device text reaches a model
An unauthenticated attacker can write into device output: a syslog line, a BGP reset reason, an interface description. Everything here exists so that text can never become an instruction.
Raw command output. Four fields are
Anyone who can make a device log a line
measured: 5,634 chars of prose in one run
A parser guarantees the SHAPE of a record:
which fields exist, of what type. It makes no
promise at all about what the strings say.
So a parsed record is not a safe record —
that is the whole reason step 3 exists.
Three rules, applied to every projection:
the raw buffer never crosses: "748 chars withheld"
and any embedded delimiter is stripped first.
an error is matched to a known-safe phrase and
re-emitted; the original string is never forwarded.
Typed fields, plus device prose that is
THE FIVE PATHS FROM DEVICE TEXT TO A MODEL
an invariant that holds for every internal caller is not an invariant — it is a convention that has not yet met a new consumer
Structurally cannot leak: the module never holds raw text in the first place.
Projected before the prompt is assembled, both single-device and fabric.
Trimming happens after projection, so trimming can never re-expose raw text.
Every tool result is projected before it is appended to the conversation.
Withheld raw `commands` — but passed free text UNMARKED. Found 2026-08-18 by two independent reviewers. Fixed: B-481.
Delimiters mitigate steering. They do not eliminate it. A sufficiently persuasive
line inside the quoted block may still influence how a model words its paraphrase.
The real bound is on the OUTPUT side, and it is structural rather than textual:
the diagnosis was already computed by code before any model was invoked, and the
model's reply cannot become an action — it cannot run a command, reach a device,
or change an exit code. So steering the prose does not steer the outcome.
HOW THE GAP WAS FOUND — AND WHY IT MATTERS
B-467 shipped the projector for four paths. The MCP boundary was a fifth,
and its scope never listed it — so it inherited nothing.
Two reviewers found it independently on the same day: one by canary through
the registered tools, one by a sweep over every egress path. Both surfaces.
The convergence is the signal. One reviewer finding it is a report;
two finding it separately is a measurement.
Fixed the same day, regression-tested, and mutation-verified — the test is
proven to fail when the guard is removed, so it cannot rot into a false pass.
The design rule underneath all of this: bound what the model can DO, not what it can be told. Quoting is defence in depth; the answer being computed before the model runs is the actual guarantee.
